cohort_rule: Identical eligible all-seven-arm cohort in both sessions; positive-ratio subsets may differ by metric.
interpretation: Executed pipeline time and circuit structure for the same experimental binary; no code-size or memory inference.
intervals: Marginal 95% fixture-cluster bootstrap intervals from analysis; not a joint confidence region.
statistic: Cell-weighted geometric mean of paired ratios from the frozen analysis; no recomputation or family reweighting.
x_axis: R6 compile time / recipe compile time; right is faster
y_axis: Recipe structural cost / R6 structural cost; up is more or deeper
zero_policy: Omit nonpositive ratio cases from geometric summaries; disclose counts and never substitute pseudocounts.
